Work effectively on a self-organizing team with minimal supervision

company_research.summary: Rakuten Kobo is a mid-sized digital bookseller headquartered in Toronto, employing 200–500 people and operating as a subsidiary of the Japanese giant Rakuten. The company maintains a "startup-like" casual environment focused on eReaders, audiobooks, and software apps, with a tech stack involving mobile, server-side, and automation testing. Employee sentiment is highly positive, especially regarding culture and work-life balance (rated ~4.3/5), making it a well-regarded destination for software co-op students seeking a collaborative, engineering-focused atmosphere.
